pub fn get_dependencies(&self, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n1125\t        self.load_dependencies(issue_id)\n1126\t    }\n1127\t\n1128\t    /// Get dependency tree rooted at an issue using recursive CTE.\n1129\t    ///\n1130\t    /// # Arguments\n1131\t    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n1132\t    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n1133\t    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n1134\t    ///\n1135\t    /// # Returns\n1136\t    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n1137\t    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n1138\t        &self,\n1139\t        root_id: &str,\n1140\t        direction: &str,\n1141\t        max_depth: usize,\n1142\t    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n1143\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n1144\t\n1145\t        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n1146\t        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n1147\t            \"up\" => {\n1148\t                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n1149\t                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n1150\t                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n1151\t                (\n1152\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n1153\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n1154\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n1155\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n1156\t                )\n1157\t            }\n1158\t            _ => {\n1159\t                // \"down\" (default): what )\n1168\t            }\n1169\t        };\n1170\t\n1171\t        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n1172\t            String::new()\n1173\t        } else {\n1174\t            format!(\"AND     i.priority,\n1185\t                    0 as depth,\n1186\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n1187\t                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n1188\t                FROM             i.priority,\n1200\t                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n1201\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n1202\t                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n1203\t                FROM dependencies d\n1204\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n1205\t                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n1206\t                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n1207\t                {depth_limit}\n1208\t            )\n1209\t            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n1210\t            FROM once in path, it's a cycle\n1220\t            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n1221\t            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n1222\t\n1223\t            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n1224\t                id: row.get(0)?,\n1225\t                title: row.get(1)?,\n1226\t                status: row.get(2)?,\n1227\t                priority: row.get(3)?,\n1228\t                depth:        &self,\n1597\t        model: Option<&str>,\n1598\t        harness: Option<&str>,\n1599\t    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n1600\t        let conn = )?;\n            }\n            for comment in &issue.comments {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO comments (id, issue_id, author, text, created_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, fn update_issue(&self, id: &str, changes: &IssueChanges) -> Result<()> {\n        // Validate that the bead exists\n        let exists = {\n            let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n            match conn.query_row(\"SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\", params![id], |_| {\n                Ok(true)\n            }) {\n                Ok(result) => result,\n                Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => false,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n            }\n        };\n        if !exists {\n            return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n        }\n\n        // Scan for secrets before updating (only for string fields in changes)\n        if let Some(scanner) = &*self.secret_scanner.lock().unwrap() {\n            let mut all_matches = Vec::new();\n            for field in [\n                changes.title.as_deref(),\n                changes.description.as_deref(),\n                changes.design.as_deref(),\n                changes.acceptance_criteria.as_deref(),\n                changes.notes.as_deref(),\n                changes.assignee.as_deref(),\n                changes.owner.as_deref(),\n                changes.external_ref.as_deref(),\n            ] {\n                if let Some(value) = field {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(value));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(labels) = &changes.labels {\n                for label in labels {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(label));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(annotations) = &changes.annotations {\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(key));\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(value));\n                }\n            }\n            if !all_matches.is_empty() {\n                return Err(SecretError(format_secret_matches(&all_matches)).into());\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            // Get current status before update (for reopen detection)\n            let current_status: Option<Status> = tx.query_row(\n                \"SELECT status FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                params![id],\n                |row| {\n                    let status_str: String = row.get(0)?;\n                    Ok(match status_str.as_str() {\n                        \"open\" => Status::Open,\n                        \"in_progress\" => Status::InProgress,\n                        \"blocked\" => Status::Blocked,\n                        \"deferred\" => Status::Deferred,\n                        \"draft\" => Status::Draft,\n                        \"closed\" => Status::Closed,\n                        \"tombstone\" => Status::Tombstone,\n                        \"pinned\" => Status::Pinned,\n                        _ => Status::Custom(status_str),\n                    })\n                },\n            ).ok();\n\n            // Current assignee before update (for assignee-change events)\n            let current_assignee: Option<String> = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT assignee FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |row| row.get(0),\n                )\n                .ok()\n                .flatten();\n\n            let mut updates = Vec::new();\n            let mut params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = Vec::new();\n            if let Some(ref title) = changes.title {\n                updates.push(\"title = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(title.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref description) = changes.description {\n                updates.push(\"description = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(description.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref design) = changes.design {\n                updates.push(\"design = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(design.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref acceptance_criteria) = changes.acceptance_criteria {\n                updates.push(\"acceptance_criteria = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(acceptance_criteria.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref notes) = changes.notes {\n                updates.push(\"notes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(notes.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref status) = changes.status {\n                updates.push(\"status = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(status.to_string()));\n                // Clear closed fields when transitioning from closed/tombstone to open\n                if !matches!(status, Status::Closed | Status::Tombstone) {\n                    updates.push(\"closed_at = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"close_reason = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"closed_by_session = NULL\");\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(priority) = changes.priority {\n                updates.push(\"priority = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(priority));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref issue_type) = changes.issue_type {\n                updates.push(\"issue_type = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(issue_type.to_string()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref assignee) = changes.assignee {\n                if assignee.trim().is_empty() {\n                    // Clearing stores NULL, never an empty string that would\n                    // read back as \"assigned\" and hide the bead from claiming.\n                    updates.push(\"assignee = NULL\");\n                } else {\n                    updates.push(\"assignee = ?\");\n                    params.push(Box::new(assignee.clone()));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(ref owner) = changes.owner {\n                updates.push(\"owner = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(owner.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(estimated_minutes) = changes.estimated_minutes {\n                updates.push(\"estimated_minutes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(estimated_minutes));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref due_at) = changes.due_at {\n                updates.push(\"due_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(due_at.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref defer_until) = changes.defer_until {\n                updates.push(\"defer_until = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(defer_until.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref external_ref) = changes.external_ref {\n                updates.push(\"external_ref = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(external_ref.clone()));\n            }\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            if !updates.is_empty() {\n                updates.push(\"updated_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(now.to_rfc3339()));\n                let query = format!(\"UPDATE issues SET {} WHERE id = ?\", updates.join(\", \"));\n                let mut all_params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = params.into_iter().collect();\n                all_params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()));\n                let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n                    all_params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n                tx.execute(&query, param_refs.as_slice())?;\n\n                // Create a Reopened event if transitioning from closed/tombstone to active status\n                if let (Some(current), Some(new)) = (current_status, changes.status.as_ref()) {\n                    if current.is_terminal() && !new.is_terminal() {\n                        let actor = changes.actor.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"system\");\n                        let now = Utc::now();\n                        tx.execute(\n                            \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'reopened', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n                            params![id, actor, current.as_str(), new.as_str(), now.to_rfc3339()],\n                        )?;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // br parity: record an assignee_changed event when the assignee changes\n                if let Some(ref new_assignee) = changes.assignee {\n                    let new_val = if new_assignee.trim().is_empty() {\n                        None\n                    } else {\n                        Some(new_assignee.as_str())\n                    };\n                    if current_assignee.as_deref() != new_val {\n                        let actor = changes.actor.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"cli\");\n                        tx.execute(\n                            \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'assignee_changed', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n                            params![id, actor, current_assignee.as_deref(), new_val, Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n                        )?;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle label updates separately\n            if let Some(ref labels) = changes.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![id])?;\n                for label in labels {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO labels (issue_id, label) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                        params![id, label],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle annotation updates separately\n            if let Some(ref annotations) = changes.annotations {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM bead_annotations WHERE bead_id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                )?;\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO bead_annotations (bead_id, key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)\",\n                        params![id, key, value],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Mark as dirty for export (if any changes were made)\n            if !updates.is_empty() || changes.labels.is_some() || changes.annotations.is_some() {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                    params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                )?;\n            }\n            // Invalidate critical path cache if status changed (affects dependency graph)\n            if changes.status.is_some() {\n                invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n                compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Update an issue from JSONL import data.\n    ///\n    /// This replaces all fields of the existing issue with the imported data,\n    /// close_issue(&self, id: &str, reason: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            // Check if bead exists\n            let exists: bool = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |_| Ok(true),\n                )\n                .unwrap_or(false);\n            if !exists {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n            }\n\n            // Check if already closed for idempotence\n            let current_status: Option<String> = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT status FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |row| row.get(0),\n                )\n                .ok();\n\n            if current_status.as_deref() == Some(\"closed\") {\n                // Already closed - idempotent, return success\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n\n            // Close the bead\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, closed_by_session = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, actor, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'closed', ?2, NULL, ?3, ?4)\",\n                params![id, actor, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            // Update worker session with close time and duration for velocity tracking\n            crate::velocity::update_session_on_close(tx, id, now)?;\n\n            // Cascade status transition: find dependents that should move from blocked->open\n            // A dependent should be unblocked if it has no remaining blockers in non-terminal status\n            let dependents: Vec<(String, String)> = tx\n                .prepare(\n                    \"SELECT d.issue_id, i.status\n                     FROM dependencies d\n                     INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.issue_id\n                     WHERE d.depends_on_id = ?1\n                     AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\",\n                )?\n                .query_map(params![id], |row| {\n                    Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))\n                })?\n                .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n            for (dep_id, dep_status) in dependents {\n                // Only transition beads currently at status='blocked'\n                if dep_status != \"blocked\" {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                // Check if the dependent has any OTHER remaining blockers not in terminal status\n                let remaining_blockers: i64 = tx\n                    .query_row(\n                        r#\"\n                        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.depends_on_id)\n                        FROM dependencies d\n                        INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                        WHERE d.issue_id = ?1\n                        AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                        AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')\n                        \"#,\n                        params![&dep_id],\n                        |row| row.get(0),\n                    )\n                    .unwrap_or(0);\n\n                // If no remaining blockers, transition to 'open'\n                if remaining_blockers == 0 {\n                    let now = Utc::now();\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'open', updated_at = ?1 WHERE id = ?2\",\n                        params![now.to_rfc3339(), &dep_id],\n                    )?;\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'status_changed', 'system', 'blocked', 'open', ?2)\",\n                        params![&dep_id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                    )?;\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                        params![&dep_id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Rebuild blocked_issues_cache to reflect the new blocker state\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM blocked_issues_cache\", [])?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO blocked_issues_cache (issue_id, blocked_by, blocked_at)\n                 SELECT d.issue_id, '[' || GROUP_CONCAT('\\\"' || d.depends_on_id || '\\\"') || ']' AS blocked_by, ?1\n                 FROM dependencies d\n                 INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                 WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')\n                 GROUP BY d.issue_id\",\n                params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n\n            // Invalidate critical path cache: closing a bead can unblock dependents\n            invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n            compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn mark_dirty(&self, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n            params![id, now],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn rebuild_blocked_cache(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM blocked_issues_cache\", [])?;\n\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO blocked_issues_cache (issue_id, blocked_by, blocked_at)\n                 SELECT d.issue_id, '[' || GROUP_CONCAT('\\\"' || d.depends_on_id || '\\\"') || ']' AS blocked_by, ?1\n                 FROM dependencies d\n                 INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                 WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')  -- TERMINAL_STATUS_SQL_LIST\n                 GROUP BY d.issue_id\",\n                params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Get all beads currently in the blocked_issues_cache.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of (issue_id, blocked_by) tuples where blocked_by is\n    /// a JSON array of blocker IDs.\n    pub fn get_blocked_issues(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT issue_id, blocked_by FROM blocked_issues_cache ORDER BY issue_id\"\n        )?;\n\n        let result = stmt\n            .query_map([], |row| {\n                Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))\n            })?\n            .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    pub fn count_issues(&self) -> Result<usize> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let count: i64 = conn.query_row(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues\", [], |row| row.get(0))?;\n        Ok(count as usize)\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_from_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<ImportResult> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            import_jsonl(jsonl_path, |issue| {\n                let existing = Self::get_issue_tx(tx, &issue.id)?;\n                match existing {\n                    None => {\n                        Self::create_issue_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                    }\n                    Some(existing_issue) => {\n                        // Compute hash from incoming issue (content_hash is None from JSONL due to #[serde(skip)])\n                        let incoming_hash = issue.content_hash();\n                        if existing_issue.content_hash.as_ref() != Some(&incoming_hash) {\n                            Self::update_issue_from_json_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            })\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_to_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path, dirty_only: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n        if dirty_only {\n            let result = export_jsonl_dirty(\n                jsonl_path,\n                || self.list_dirty_issues(),\n                || self.clear_dirty(),\n            )?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        } else {\n            let result = export_jsonl(jsonl_path, || self.list_all_issues())?;\n            // Clear dirty flags after full export (all beads are now synced)\n            self.clear_dirty()?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_issue_conn(conn: &Connection, row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Issue> {\n        let status_str: String = row.get(7)?;\n        let type_str: String = row.get(9)?;\n        let parse_opt_dt = |idx: usize| -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {\n            let s: Option<String> = row.get(idx)?;\n            match s {\n                None => Ok(None),\n                Some(ref val) if val.is_empty() => Ok(None),\n                Some(val) => Ok(Some(parse_datetime(val)?)),\n            }\n        };\n        let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n        Ok(Issue {\n            content_hash: row.get(1)?,\n            title: row.get(2)?,\n            description: row.get(3)?,\n            design: row.get(4)?,\n            acceptance_criteria: row.get(5)?,\n            notes: row.get(6)?,\n            status: Status::from_str(&status_str).unwrap_or(Status::Custom(status_str)),\n            priority: row.get(8)?,\n            issue_type: IssueType::from_str(&type_str).unwrap_or(IssueType::Custom(type_str)),\n            assignee: row.get(10)?,\n            owner: row.get(11)?,\n            estimated_minutes: row.get(12)?,\n            created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(13)?)?,\n            created_by: row.get(14)?,\n            updated_at: parse_datetime(row.get(15)?)?,\n            closed_at: parse_opt_dt(16)?,\n            close_reason: row.get(17)?,\n            closed_by_session: row.get(18)?,\n            due_at: parse_opt_dt(19)?,\n            defer_until: parse_opt_dt(20)?,\n            external_ref: delete_reason: row.get(26)?,\n            original_type: row.get(27)?,\n            compaction_level: row.get(28)?,\n            compacted_at: parse_opt_dt(29)?,\n            compacted_at_commit:       is_template: row.get::<_, i32>(35)? != 0,\n            labels: Self::load_labels_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            dependencies: Self::load_dependencies_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            comments: an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n                path: if is_cycle {\n                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n                } else {\n                    path\n                },\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(nodes)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt.query(params![depends_on_id])?;\n        let mut deps = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n            deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    pub       \"SELECT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, comment, created_at\n             FROM events WHERE 1=1\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut params.push(Box::new(dt.to_rfc3339()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = actor {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND actor = ?{}\",    let mut events = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_event(row:      params![issue_id],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn search_issues(\n        &self,\n        query: Option<&str>,\n        status: &[Status],\n        issue_type: &[IssueType],\n        assignee: Option<&str>,\n        labels: &[String],\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n        limit: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, i.external_ref, i.source_system,\n                    i.source_repo, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, i.original_type,\n                    i.compaction_level, i.compacted_at, i.compacted_at_commit, i.original_size,\n                    i.sender, i.ephemeral, i.pinned, i.is_template\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN labels l ON i.id = l.issue_id\n             WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n        if let Some(q) = query {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \" AND (i.title LIKE ?{} OR i.description LIKE ?{})\",\n                param_idx,\n                param_idx + 1\n            ));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            param_idx += 2;\n        }\n        for s in status {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.status = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i))\n                .collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR \")));\n            for label in labels {\n                params.push(label.clone());\n                param_idx += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(min) = priority_min {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(min.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(max) = priority_max {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, i.created_at ASC\");\n        if limit > 0 {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", limit));\n        }\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n            params.iter().map(|p| p as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(issues)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<Stats> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let total: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM    }\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the score of the top candidate bead for claiming.\n    ///\n    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    ///\n    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n        &self,\n        model: Option<&str>,\n        harness: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n                     AND vs.model = ?1\n                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n .beads/)\n42\t///\n43\t/// # Returns\n44\t/// * `Ok(DoctorResult)` - Health check results\n45\tpub fn check(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<DoctorResult> {\n46\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n47\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n48\t    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n49\t    let false;\n70\t        issues.push(\"JSONL file contains invalid lines\".to_string());\n71\t    }\n72\t\n73\t    // Check consistency with content_hash comparison\n74\t    if db_ok && jsonl_ok {\n75\t + drift.hash_mismatch.len();\n80\t\n81\t        result.missing_in_jsonl = drift.missing_in_jsonl.clone();\n82\t        result.missing_in_sqlite = drift.missing_in_sqlite.clone();\n83\t        result.hash_mismatch = drift.hash_mismatch.clone();\n84\t\n85\t        if total_drift > 0 {\n86\t            issues.push(format!(\n87\t                \"Drift detected: {} missing in JSONL, {} missing unflushed_count\n102\t            ));\n103\t        }\n104\t    }\n105\t\n106\t    // Check for beads stuck in a done-sounding custom status instead of closed/tombstone\n107\t    // (bf-wre). NOT deleted\n152\t    // 3. COUNT of active blockers (non-terminal status) = 0\n153\t    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n154\t        r#\"\n155\t        SELECT i.id\n156\t        FROM issues i\n157\t        WHERE i.status = 'blocked'\n158\t        AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n159\t        AND (\n160\t            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.depends_on_id)\n161\t            FROM dependencies d\n162\t            INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = d.depends_on_id\n163\t            WHERE d.issue_id = i.id\n164\t            AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n165\t            AND blocker.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')\n166\t        ) = 0\n167\t        ORDER BY i.id\n168\t        \"#\n169\t    )?;\n170\t\n171\t    let ids = stmt\n172\t        .query_map([], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0))?\n173\t        .collect::<rusqlite::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;\n174\t    Ok(ids)\n175\t}\n176\t\n177\t/// Find beads whose status is a `TERMINAL_STATUS_ALIASES` value (e.g. \"completed\",\n178\t/// \"done\") rather than the canonical \"closed\"/\"tombstone\". These beads are functionally\n179\t/// terminal (see `Status::is_terminal()`) but weren't actually closed, so `bf show`/`bf\n180\t/// list` still displays them as active and `closed_at`/`close_reason` .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n188\t        .join(\", \");\n189\t    let query = format!(\n190\t        \"SELECT id FROM issues WHERE LOWER(status) IN ({placeholders}) AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY .collect::<rusqlite::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;\n196\t    Ok(ids)\n197\t}\n198\t\n199\t/// Check database integrity.\n200\tfn check_database(db_path: &Path) -> Result<(usize, bool)> {\n201\t    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n202\t    conn.busy_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))?;\n203\t\n204\t    // Apply schema if database is new (no tables yet)\n205\t    let needs_schema: bool = conn\n206\t        .query_row(\n207\t            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='issues'\",\n208\t            [],\n209\t            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0),\n210\t        )\n211\t        .map(|n| n == 0)\n212\t        .unwrap_or(true);\n213\t    if needs_schema {\n214\t        crate::storage::schema::apply_schema(&conn)?;\n215\t    }\n216\t\n217\t    // Run {\n235\t    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n236\t        return Ok((0, true)); // Empty workspace is valid\n237\t    }\n238\t\n239\t    let mut count = 0;\n240\t    let mut valid = true;\n241\t\n242\t    match stream_issues(jsonl_path) {\n243\t        Ok(iter) => {\n244\t            for result in iter {\n245\t                match result {\n246\t                    Ok(_) => count += 1,\n247\t         }\n253\t        }\n254\t        Err(e) => {\n255\t            return Err(anyhow!(\"Failed to read JSONL file: {}\", e));\n256\t        }\n257\t    }\n258\t\n259\t    Ok((count, valid))\n260\t}\n261\t\n262\t/// Consistency drift details.\n263\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\n264\tstruct ConsistencyDrift {\n265\t    /// Bead IDs that exist in SQLite but not in JSONL\n266\t JSONL and SQLite to detect drift.\n276\tfn check_consistency_with_hash(db_path: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<ConsistencyDrift> {\n277\t    use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};\n278\t\n279\t    let storage = Storage::open(db_path)?;\n280\t\n281\t    // Build a map of all SQLite issues with their content_hash\n282\t    let sqlite_issues: HashMap<String, String> = storage\n283\t        .list_all_issues()?\n284\t        .into_iter()\n285\t        .map(|issue| {\n286\t            let hash = issue.content_hash();\n287\t            (issue.id, hash)\n288\t sqlite_issues.get(&bead_id) {\n304\t                Some(sqlite_hash) => {\n305\t                    if sqlite_hash != &jsonl_hash {\n306\t                        drift.hash_mismatch.push(bead_id);\n307\t                    }\n308\t                }\n309\t                None => {\n310\t                    drift.missing_in_sqlite.push(bead_id);\n311\t                }\n312\t            }\n313\t        }\n314\t    }\n315\t\n316\t    // Find beads in SQLite but not in JSONL (using tracked seen IDs)\n317\t    for bead_id in sqlite_issues.keys() {\n318\t flush to JSONL).\n330\tpub fn count_unflushed(db_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n331\t    use rusqlite::Connection;\n332\t\n333\t    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n334\t    conn.busy_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))?;\n335\t\n336\t    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n337\t    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n338\t        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM get_unflushed_ids(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n357\t    use rusqlite::Connection;\n358\t\n359\t    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n360\t    conn.busy_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))?;\n361\t\n362\t    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n363\t    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n364\t        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dirty_issues'\",\n365\t        [],\n366\t        |row| row.get(0),\n367\t    )?;\n368\t\n369\t    if table_exists == 0 {\n370\t        return ids = Vec::new();\n377\t    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n378\t        ids.push(row.get(0)?);\n379\t    }\n380\t\n381\t    Ok(ids)\n382\t}\n383\t\n384\t/// Repair the database by rebuilding from JSONL.\n385\t///\n386\t/// This is the recovery operation when the database is corrupted or missing.\n387\t/// The JSONL file is the authoritative source of truth for repair.\n388\t///\n389\t/// # Arguments\n390\t/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n391\t/// * `flush_first` - If true, flush unflushed beads to JSONL before repairing\n392\t/// * `force` - If true, proceed even with unflushed beads (they will be lost)\n393\t///\n394\t/// # Returns\n395\t/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\n396\tpub fn repair(workspace_dir: &Path, flush_first: bool, force: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n397\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n398\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n399\t    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n400\t    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n401\t    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n402\t\n403\t    // Check if JSONL exists\n404\t    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n405\t        return Err(anyhow!(\n406\t            \"Cannot repair: JSONL file not found at {}\",\n407\t            jsonl_path.display()\n408\t        ));\n409\t    }\n410\t\n411\t    // Check for unflushed beads if database exists and is valid\n412\t    // If db is corrupted, we can't detect unflushed beads - proceed with warning\n413\t    let (unflushed_ids, db_corrupted) = if db_path.exists() {\n414\t        match get_unflushed_ids(&db_path) {\n415\t            Ok(ids) => (ids, false),\n416\t            Err(_) => {\n417\t                // Database is corrupted or unreadable\n418\t                // We can't detect unflushed beads, so proceed with a warning\n419\t                if flush_first {\n420\t                    // Cannot flush from a corrupt database\n421\t                    return Err(anyhow!(\n422\t                        \"Cannot flush: database is corrupted and unreadable.\\n\\\n423\t                         Flushing from a corrupt DB would poison the JSONL checkpoint.\\n\\\n424\t                         Unflushed beads cannot be recovered.\\n\\\n425\t                         Remove --flush-first to proceed with repair only.\"\n426\t                    ));\n427\t                }\n428\t                // Proceed without unflushed check (db is unreadable)\n429\t                // No --force needed since we can't detect unflushed beads anyway\n430\t                eprintln!(\"WARNING: Database is corrupted and unreadable.\");\n431\t                eprintln!(\"  Cannot detect unflushed beads - any db-only beads will be lost.\");\n432\t                eprintln!(\"  Proceeding with repair from JSONL...\");\n433\t                (Vec::new(), true)\n434\t            }\n435\t        }\n436\t    } else {\n437\t        // DB doesn't exist - no unflushed beads possible\n438\t        (Vec::new(), must export everything because repair will rebuild db from JSONL\n445\t            eprintln!(\n446\t                \"Flushing all beads to JSONL before repair (including {} unflushed)...\",\n447\t                unflushed_ids.len()\n448\t            );\n449\t            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n450\t            let flushed = storage.sync_to_jsonl(&jsonl_path, false)?;\n451\t            eprintln!(\"Flushed {} bead(s) to JSONL\", flushed);\n452\t        } else if !force {\n453\t            // Refuse to proceed with unflushed beads\n454\t            return Err(anyhow!(\n455\t                \"Cannot repair: {} unflushed bead(s) exist ({}).\\n\\\n456\t                 Run 'bf doctor --repair --flush-first' to flush before repair,\\n\\\n457\t                 or 'bf doctor --repair --force' to proceed (these beads will be LOST).\\n\\\n458\t                 Unflushed beads: {}\",\n459\t                unflushed_ids.len(),\n460\t                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n461\t                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n462\t                } else {\n463\t                    format!(\n464\t                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n465\t                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n466\t                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n467\t                    )\n468\t                },\n469\t                unflushed_ids.join(\", \")\n470\t            ));\n471\t        } else {\n472\t            // Force mode: warn but proceed\n473\t            eprintln!(\n474\t                \"WARNING: {} unflushed bead(s) will be LOST: {}\",\n475\t                unflushed_ids.len(),\n476\t                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n477\t                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n478\t                } else {\n479\t                    format!(\n480\t                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n481\t                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n482\t                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n483\t                    )\n484\t                }\n485\t            );\n486\t            eprintln!(\"Proceeding with repair due to --force flag\");\n487\t        }\n488\t    }\n489\t\n490\t    // Backup existing database if it exists\n491\t    if db_path.exists() {\n492\t        let &backup_path)?;\n497\t        eprintln!(\"Backed up existing database to {}\", backup_path.display());\n498\t    }\n499\t\n500\t    // Delete old database\n501\t    if db_path.exists() {\n502\t        std::fs::remove_file(&db_path)?;\n503\t    }\n504\t\n505\t    // Create new database and import JSONL\n506\t    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n507\t\n508\t    let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n509\t        import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n510\t            Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n511\t            Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n512\t        })\n513\t    })?;\n514\t\n515\t    // Rebuild blocked cache\n516\t    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n517\t\n518\t    // Clear dirty marks - after rebuild from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n519\t    // (create_issue_tx doesn't mark dirty, but we clear for safety)\n520\t    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n521\t\n522\t    Ok(result.imported)\n523\t}\n524\t\n525\t/// Rebuild the blocked issues cache.\n526\t///\n527\t/// This materialized view should be rebuilt after dependency or status changes.\n528\tpub fn rebuild_cache(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n529\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n530\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n531\t    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n532\t    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n533\t\n534\t    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n535\t    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n536\t\n537\t    Ok(())\n538\t}\n539\t\n540\t/// Reclaim stale in_progress beads.\n541\t///\n542\t/// Resets beads that have been in_progress for longer than the TTL\n543\t/// back to open status.\n544\t///\n545\t/// # Arguments\n546\t/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n547\t/// * `ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes (default from config is 30)\n548\t///\n549\t/// # Returns\n550\t/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads reclaimed\n551\tpub fn reclaim_stale(workspace_dir: &Path, ttl_minutes: i64) -> Result<usize> {\n552\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n553\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n554\t    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n555\t    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n556\t\n557\t    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n558\t\n559\t    let reclaimed = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n560\t        let stale_cutoff = chrono::Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::minutes(ttl_minutes);\n561\t\n562\t        let reclaimed = tx.execute(\n563\t            \"UPDATE issues\n564\t             SET status = 'open', assignee = NULL, updated_at = ?\n565\t             WHERE status = 'in_progress' AND updated_at < ?\",\n566\t            rusqlite::params![chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(), stale_cutoff.to_rfc3339()],\n567\t        )?;\n568\t\n569\t        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(reclaimed)\n570\t    })?;\n571\t\n572\t    Ok(reclaimed)\n573\t}\n574\t\n575\t/// Initialize a new database from an existing JSONL file.\n576\t///\n577\t/// Use this to .beads/)\n582\t/// * `jsonl_path` - Path to the JSONL file to import from\n583\t///\n584\t/// # Returns\n585\t/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\n586\tpub fn init_from_jsonl(workspace_dir: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n587\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n588\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n603\t            Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n604\t        })\n605\t    })?;\n606\t\n607\t    // Rebuild blocked cache\n608\t    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n609\t\n610\t    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n611\t    // (create_issue_tx doesn't mark dirty, but we clear for safety)\n612\t    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n613\t\n614\t    Ok(result.imported)\n615\t}\n616\t\n617\t/// Verify database schema version.\n618\t///\n619\t/// Checks that all required tables and indexes {\n                    format!(\n                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n                    )\n                }\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Proceeding with repair due to --force flag\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Backup existing database if it exists\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        let backup_path = db_path.with_extension(&format!(\n            \"db.backup.{}\",\n            chrono::Utc::now().format(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")\n        ));\n        std::fs::copy(&db_path, &backup_path)?;\n        eprintln!(\"Backed up existing database to {}\", backup_path.display());\n    }\n\n    // Delete old database\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        std::fs::remove_file(&db_path)?;\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n            Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n            Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n        })\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after rebuild from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    // (create_issue_tx doesn't mark dirty, but we clear for safety)\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Rebuild the blocked issues cache.\n///\n/// This materialized view should be rebuilt after dependency or status changes.\npub fn rebuild_cache(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Reclaim stale in_progress beads.\n///\n/// Resets beads that have been in_progress for longer than the TTL\n/// back to open status.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes (default from config is 30)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads reclaimed\npub fn reclaim_stale(workspace_dir: &Path, ttl_minutes: i64) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let reclaimed = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        let stale_cutoff = chrono::Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::minutes(ttl_minutes);\n\n        let reclaimed = tx.execute(\n            \"UPDATE issues\n             SET status = 'open', assignee = NULL, updated_at = ?\n             WHERE status = 'in_progress' AND updated_at < ?\",\n            rusqlite::params![chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(), stale_cutoff.to_rfc3339()],\n        )?;\n\n        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(reclaimed)\n    })?;\n\n    Ok(reclaimed)\n}\n\n/// Initialize a new database from an existing JSONL file.\n///\n/// Use this to create a fresh database from a JSONL export without\n/// affecting the existing database.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `jsonl_path` - Path to the JSONL file to import from\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\npub fn init_from_jsonl(workspace_dir: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    // Check if JSONL exists\n    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"JSONL file not found at {}\", jsonl_path.display()));\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        import_jsonl(jsonl_path, |issue| {\n            Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n            Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n        })\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    // (create_issue_tx doesn't mark dirty, but we clear for safety)\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Verify database schema version.\n///\n/// Checks that all required tables and indexes exist.\npub fn verify_schema(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(&db_path)?;\n    conn.busy_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))?;\n\n    // Check for critical tables\n    let tables = [\n        \"issues\",\n        \"dependencies\",\n        \"labels\",\n        \"comments\",\n        \"events\",\n        \"config\",\n        \"metadata\",\n        \"dirty_issues\",\n        \"export_hashes\",\n        \"blocked_issues_cache\",\n        \"child_counters\",\n    ];\n\n    for table in &tables {\n        let exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?1\",\n            &[table],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n\n        if exists == 0 {\n            eprintln!(\"Missing table: {}\", table);\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(true)\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::config::init_workspace;\n    use crate::jsonl::export_jsonl;\n    use crate::model::{Issue, IssueType, Priority, Status};\n
